storyCards.headline: Burning Down The House: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Talking Heads's "Burning Down The House" reached #9 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Burning Down the House" is a song by the American rock band Talking Heads, released in July 1983 by Sire Records as the first single from their fifth studio album Speaking in Tongues.

The song became their only top ten single on the U.S.

Billboard Hot 100, where it peaked at No.

The song peaked at #9 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #9 on the Hot 100.
